title: TAVI API — the three NDC-2536 items, 26 Oct 2026, owner (on QA W5 Module)
lines: 1 More than one currency: GET /currencies, /iam/tenant/currencies, /settings/currencies -> 404; company has one currency (EGP)
2 Validation rule on a pick list: POST validation-rules {condition: "qa_w5_pick_list == 'Blue'"} -> 201 (now accepted)
...but a record with Pick List = Blue is saved: 201 (the rule is never applied, see W5-B1)
"sum(...)" -> 400 "Unknown function 'sum'. Available: abs, coalesce, concat, if, isblank, len, lower, max, min, number, round, text, trim, upper."
